anomalies.description: A large group of people, many carrying banners and flags, is actively clashing with police and engaging in coordinated aggressive behavior (surrounding, rocking, striking the van, throwing objects), constituting collective violent unrest beyond a peaceful demonstration.

Multiple individuals in dark clothing are engaged in mutual physical combat around and against a stationary police van; actions include punching, kicking, pulling, and grappling with officers and each other, with repeated contact visible across frames.

A large group of people, many carrying banners and moving aggressively, engage in coordinated disruptive activity around the police van; multiple individuals throw objects, run toward/away from officers, and clash with law enforcement, indicating collective violent unrest.
Multiple individuals in dark clothing surround and physically assault a person near the front-left side of the police van; visible grappling, pushing, and striking occur over several frames.

After initial struggle, one individual appears subdued on the ground near the van’s front wheel while others continue to strike or kick them; the victim is not actively resisting during this interval.

A large group of people, many in dark clothing and some holding banners, are engaged in violent unrest on a street, surrounding and confronting a stationary police van. Individuals are seen running, pushing, throwing objects (e.g., a helmet or object visible on ground at f2), and engaging in physical clashes with others and possibly officers near the vehicle.
Multiple instances of mutual physical combat occur among individuals in the crowd near the police van, including grappling, shoving, and striking motions observed across successive frames.

Multiple individuals are observed in close physical combat: one person in dark clothing appears to strike another near the center of the crowd (visible in f1–f3), and others grapple or push each other. These are mutual physical engagements, not one-sided attacks.

A large crowd of people, many wearing dark clothing and some holding banners or shields, is engaged in violent group clashes with police or security personnel near a parked police van. Individuals are seen throwing objects, running, and engaging in physical confrontations across multiple frames. The scene shows sustained collective unrest with dynamic movement and apparent conflict.

In frames f5–f7, a person in light-colored clothing is on the ground near the curb while another individual stands over them and appears to strike or kick them; the grounded person shows no active resistance, suggesting a helpless victim being attacked.

A large crowd of people, many wearing dark clothing and some holding banners or shields, is engaged in violent unrest on a street intersection. Individuals are seen throwing objects, running, and clashing with others; police vehicles are present and appear to be retreating or being surrounded. Debris is visible on the road surface, and the overall behavior indicates collective violent disorder rather than a peaceful protest.

Multiple individuals in the crowd are observed engaging in mutual physical combat: punching, grappling, and pushing each other in close proximity near the center of the intersection. These interactions involve more than two people and occur repeatedly across frames.
